I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I couldn't confirm that Elodie Merriwether is the main contact for the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply. None of the files Ilse can see mention Marrow Agrisupply or a Halyard rollout. The North team cheat sheet only covers Quarrendon Freight Lines, Tamsin Cold Chain and Brackenwater Freight Co.

My reply said I'd "noted it, but only as unverified," and I can't edit it. That wording is a bit loose: I didn't save the tip anywhere. I'm not recording Elodie as a fact in any account record or digest. I also told Ilse I'd treat it as settled once the Marrow account owner or the CRM confirms it.
